Job Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our AI systems, solutions, and products.
Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable and maintainable backend systems using a variety of programming languages.
Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate backend systems with user-facing applications.
Optimize database performance and implement data security measures.
Write clean, maintainable code that follows best practices and adheres to coding standards
Troubleshoot and debug issues as they arise.
Write unit tests and participate in code reviews to ensure the quality and reliability of our products.
Building, releasing, and maintaining containerized solutions.
Requirements
3+ years of professional software development experience
2+ years of experience in backend development using Python or GoLang
Experience with database design and management
AI development experience: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Nice-to-haves
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker / Kubernetes
Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure
Experience building and supporting continuous integration and deployment tools
